title: Explained | The Stock Market | FULL EPISODE | Netflix
speaker: Netflix
zh: 【Netflix】解釋 |股市|完整影集 | Netflix（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: I've always wondered myself, why do we have to hear this every night, what the stock market is doing.
cues.en: I've always wondered myself, why do we have to hear this every night, what the stock market is doing.
cues.zh: 我一直在想，為什麼我們每天晚上都要聽到這個，股市正在做什麼。

cues.text: Seventy record closing highs so far...
cues.en: Seventy record closing highs so far...
cues.zh: 迄今創下七十個收盤新高...

cues.text: Blasting through a ceiling In a record-setting IPO.
cues.en: Blasting through a ceiling In a record-setting IPO.
cues.zh: 突破天花板，創紀錄的首次公開募股。

cues.text: Investors who've been riding the wave... When the market's booming, we're made to believe the economy is booming.
cues.en: Investors who've been riding the wave... When the market's booming, we're made to believe the economy is booming.
cues.zh: 一直在乘風破浪的投資者…當市場蓬勃發展時，我們就會相信經濟正在蓬勃發展。

cues.text: And in America, the stock market has been mostly booming for almost 40 years,
cues.en: And in America, the stock market has been mostly booming for almost 40 years,
cues.zh: 在美國，股市近 40 年來一直在蓬勃發展，

cues.text: As the stock market goes, so goes the wealth and the health of the American economy.
cues.en: As the stock market goes, so goes the wealth and the health of the American economy.
cues.zh: 隨著股市的走勢，美國經濟的財富和健康狀況也會隨之改變。

cues.text: What the market is telling us is that we are on the road to prosperity.
cues.en: What the market is telling us is that we are on the road to prosperity.
cues.zh: 市場告訴我們的是，我們正走在繁榮之路上。

cues.text: ...a sky-rocketing stock market, and that benefits everyone.
cues.en: ...a sky-rocketing stock market, and that benefits everyone.
cues.zh: ……股市飛漲，這對每個人都有好處。

cues.text: The stock market has gained almost three trillion dollars in value since the election.
cues.en: The stock market has gained almost three trillion dollars in value since the election.
cues.zh: 自大選以來，股市價值已增加近三兆美元。

cues.text: But if you add up all the goods and services bought and sold in the US,
cues.en: But if you add up all the goods and services bought and sold in the US,
cues.zh: 但如果你把在美國買賣的所有商品和服務加起來，

cues.text: the actual economy, that number isn't growing as quickly as it used to.
cues.en: the actual economy, that number isn't growing as quickly as it used to.
cues.zh: 就實際經濟而言，這個數字的成長速度不像以前那麼快。

cues.text: Wages have hardly budged in decades and the average American family's net worth
cues.en: Wages have hardly budged in decades and the average American family's net worth
cues.zh: 幾十年來工資幾乎沒有變化，而美國家庭的平均淨資產

cues.text: still hasn't recovered from the Great Recession.
cues.en: still hasn't recovered from the Great Recession.
cues.zh: 仍未從大衰退中恢復過來。

cues.text: So what exactly is the stock market measuring?
cues.en: So what exactly is the stock market measuring?
cues.zh: 那麼股市到底在衡量什麼？

cues.text: The barometer of America's prosperity has been the stock exchange.
cues.en: The barometer of America's prosperity has been the stock exchange.
cues.zh: 美國繁榮的晴雨表是證券交易所。

cues.text: Look at the Dow, it's currently up by...
cues.en: Look at the Dow, it's currently up by...
cues.zh: 看看道瓊斯指數，目前上漲了...

cues.text: The NASDAQ finally hit 5,000.
cues.en: The NASDAQ finally hit 5,000.
cues.zh: 那斯達克指數最終突破5000點。

cues.text: Investors are salivating...
cues.en: Investors are salivating...
cues.zh: 投資人垂涎欲滴…

cues.text: Dividends! A new kind of gold rush...
cues.en: Dividends! A new kind of gold rush...
cues.zh: 股息！一種新的淘金熱.....

cues.text: We are all watching this global economic expansion...
cues.en: We are all watching this global economic expansion...
cues.zh: 我們都在關注全球經濟擴張...

cues.text: We are now in historic territory...
cues.en: We are now in historic territory...
cues.zh: 我們現在處於歷史領土...

cues.text: A stock buy-back...
cues.en: A stock buy-back...
cues.zh: 股票回購...

cues.text: It's a fundamentally psychopathic philosophy.
cues.en: It's a fundamentally psychopathic philosophy.
cues.zh: 這是一種根本上的精神病態哲學。

cues.text: To understand what stock markets are measuring, it helps to imagine a very simple business like a lemonade stand.
cues.en: To understand what stock markets are measuring, it helps to imagine a very simple business like a lemonade stand.
cues.zh: 要了解股票市場的衡量標準，可以想像一個非常簡單的業務，例如檸檬水攤。

cues.text: Jill is killing it. But I'm thinking bigger.
cues.en: Jill is killing it. But I'm thinking bigger.
cues.zh: 吉爾正在殺死它。但我的想法更大。

cues.text: I tried to get a loan, but the bank said it was too risky.
cues.en: I tried to get a loan, but the bank said it was too risky.
cues.zh: 我試著貸款，但銀行說風險太大。

cues.text: The rich investors weren't buying.
cues.en: The rich investors weren't buying.
cues.zh: 富有的投資者並沒有購買。

cues.text: Jill has another option.
cues.en: Jill has another option.
cues.zh: 吉爾還有另一個選擇。

cues.text: She can go public, giving anyone who wants to, the chance to invest in her business...
cues.en: She can go public, giving anyone who wants to, the chance to invest in her business...
cues.zh: 她可以上市，為任何願意的人提供投資她的企業的機會...

cues.text: ...through something called an initial public offering or IPO.
cues.en: ...through something called an initial public offering or IPO.
cues.zh: ……透過稱為首次公開募股或首次公開募股的方式。

cues.text: Investors pay a certain amount, say a dollar, to own a small part or share of Jill's business.
cues.en: Investors pay a certain amount, say a dollar, to own a small part or share of Jill's business.
cues.zh: 投資者支付一定金額（例如一美元）即可擁有吉爾業務的一小部分或股份。

cues.text: Jill sells a bunch of shares.
cues.en: Jill sells a bunch of shares.
cues.zh: 吉爾賣掉了一堆股票。

cues.text: And I grow my lemonade empire!
cues.en: And I grow my lemonade empire!
cues.zh: 我也發展了我的檸檬水帝國！

cues.text: Right, Jill can put that money towards opening new lemonade stands,
cues.en: Right, Jill can put that money towards opening new lemonade stands,
cues.zh: 是的，吉爾可以用這筆錢開設新的檸檬水攤位，

cues.text: which means more profits.
cues.en: which means more profits.
cues.zh: 這意味著更多的利潤。

cues.text: Jill can put some of those profits towards developing new products.
cues.en: Jill can put some of those profits towards developing new products.
cues.zh: 吉爾可以將其中一些利潤用於開發新產品。

cues.text: She can also give some of that money back to her investors.
cues.en: She can also give some of that money back to her investors.
cues.zh: 她還可以將部分資金回饋給投資者。

cues.text: These are called dividends.
cues.en: These are called dividends.
cues.zh: 這些稱為股息。

cues.text: She doesn't have to do this, but it does help get people excited
cues.en: She doesn't have to do this, but it does help get people excited
cues.zh: 她不必這樣做，但這確實有助於讓人興奮

cues.text: about her company and more likely to buy her stock, like Sam. He was sick on IPO day, but he thinks...
cues.en: about her company and more likely to buy her stock, like Sam. He was sick on IPO day, but he thinks...
cues.zh: 瞭解她的公司，更有可能買她的股票，就像山姆一樣。 IPO 當天他生病了，但他認為…

cues.text: Jill is the smartest girl in the whole world, and I know this lemonade stand thing is gonna be huge.
cues.en: Jill is the smartest girl in the whole world, and I know this lemonade stand thing is gonna be huge.
cues.zh: 吉爾是世界上最聰明的女孩，我知道這個檸檬水攤的生意會很大。

cues.text: So he offers to buy some shares from one of the original investors
cues.en: So he offers to buy some shares from one of the original investors
cues.zh: 所以他提出從一位原始投資者購買一些股票

cues.text: for twice what she paid for them.
cues.en: for twice what she paid for them.
cues.zh: 價格是她購買的兩倍。

cues.text: He's thinking...
cues.en: He's thinking...
cues.zh: 他在想…

cues.text: That's the stock market.
cues.en: That's the stock market.
cues.zh: 這就是股市。

cues.text: It's people buying and selling tiny pieces of companies, based on how much they think those pieces will be worth in the future.
cues.en: It's people buying and selling tiny pieces of companies, based on how much they think those pieces will be worth in the future.
cues.zh: 人們根據他們認為這些公司未來的價值來買賣公司的小部分。

cues.text: Except in real life, it's happening thousands of times a second, all over the world.
cues.en: Except in real life, it's happening thousands of times a second, all over the world.
cues.zh: 除了在現實生活中之外，這種情況在世界各地每秒發生數千次。

cues.text: There are stock markets everywhere, but the New York Stock Exchange is the big kahuna.
cues.en: There are stock markets everywhere, but the New York Stock Exchange is the big kahuna.
cues.zh: 到處都有股票市場，但紐約證券交易所才是最大的市場。

cues.text: It's been around since 1792, when 24 stockbrokers put on their finest short pants and top hats
cues.en: It's been around since 1792, when 24 stockbrokers put on their finest short pants and top hats
cues.zh: 它自 1792 年以來一直存在，當時 24 名股票經紀人穿上了他們最好的短褲和高頂帽子

cues.text: and got together under a buttonwood tree on Wall Street in New York City.
cues.en: and got together under a buttonwood tree on Wall Street in New York City.
cues.zh: 並在紐約華爾街的一棵梧桐樹下聚會。

cues.text: Today, it's where shares in big traditional companies like IBM and GE are traded.
cues.en: Today, it's where shares in big traditional companies like IBM and GE are traded.
cues.zh: 如今，IBM 和 GE 等大型傳統公司的股票都在這裡交易。

cues.text: The NASDAQ is the cooler younger brother.
cues.en: The NASDAQ is the cooler younger brother.
cues.zh: 納斯達克是更酷的弟弟。

cues.text: It was born in 1971 and doesn't have a physical location.
cues.en: It was born in 1971 and doesn't have a physical location.
cues.zh: 它誕生於 1971 年，沒有實際位置。

cues.text: All the trading happens electronically.
cues.en: All the trading happens electronically.
cues.zh: 所有交易均以電子方式進行。

cues.text: That's where you find tech companies like Apple and Facebook.
cues.en: That's where you find tech companies like Apple and Facebook.
cues.zh: 在那裡你可以找到蘋果和 Facebook 等科技公司。

cues.text: So, in America if you want to know how the stock market is doing, both these exchanges are doing.
cues.en: So, in America if you want to know how the stock market is doing, both these exchanges are doing.
cues.zh: 所以，在美國，如果你想知道股市表現如何，這兩個交易所都在做。

cues.text: That's where indexes come in.
cues.en: That's where indexes come in.
cues.zh: 這就是索引發揮作用的地方。

cues.text: They take a whole bunch of share prices and transform them into one clean number.
cues.en: They take a whole bunch of share prices and transform them into one clean number.
cues.zh: 他們將一大堆股價轉化為一個乾淨的數字。

cues.text: The S&P 500 tracks 500 of the largest companies on both exchanges,
cues.en: The S&P 500 tracks 500 of the largest companies on both exchanges,
cues.zh: 標準普爾 500 指數追蹤兩家交易所最大的 500 家公司，

cues.text: While the Dow is a lot more exclusive.
cues.en: While the Dow is a lot more exclusive.
cues.zh: 而道瓊指數則更為獨特。

cues.text: It only follows the 30 companies it considers the most important.
cues.en: It only follows the 30 companies it considers the most important.
cues.zh: 它只關注它認為最重要的 30 家公司。

cues.text: In 2015, it booted out AT&T and replaced it with Apple.
cues.en: In 2015, it booted out AT&T and replaced it with Apple.
cues.zh: 2015年，它淘汰了AT&T，並用蘋果取代。

cues.text: The Dow and S&P are big American indexes, but other countries have their own indexes
cues.en: The Dow and S&P are big American indexes, but other countries have their own indexes
cues.zh: 道瓊斯指數和標準普爾指數是美國的大型指數，但其他國家也有自己的指數

cues.text: to measure their stock markets.
cues.en: to measure their stock markets.
cues.zh: 來衡量他們的股票市場。

cues.text: The German stock index, Dax...
cues.en: The German stock index, Dax...
cues.zh: 德國股票指數Dax...

cues.text: London's FTSE 100 index...
cues.en: London's FTSE 100 index...
cues.zh: 倫敦富時 100 指數...

cues.text: The Nikkei index...
cues.en: The Nikkei index...
cues.zh: 日經指數...

cues.text: The Shanghai index...
cues.en: The Shanghai index...
cues.zh: 上證指數...

cues.text: Today, many of the world's biggest companies are publicly traded, but that wasn't always the case.
cues.en: Today, many of the world's biggest companies are publicly traded, but that wasn't always the case.
cues.zh: 如今，世界上許多最大的公司都是公開交易的，但情況並非總是如此。

cues.text: One guy, and it was almost always a guy, used to call all the shots.
cues.en: One guy, and it was almost always a guy, used to call all the shots.
cues.zh: 一個人，而且幾乎總是一個人，過去常常發號施令。

cues.text: Big corporations of the 1900s, most of them at that time
cues.en: Big corporations of the 1900s, most of them at that time
cues.zh: 1900 年代的大公司，其中大部分是當時的

cues.text: had a single shareholder like Andrew Carnegie, Vanderbilt.
cues.en: had a single shareholder like Andrew Carnegie, Vanderbilt.
cues.zh: 擁有像安德魯·卡內基、範德比爾特這樣的單一股東。

cues.text: Rockefeller.
cues.en: Rockefeller.
cues.zh: 洛克菲勒。

cues.text: They really exercised very tight control over these businesses.
cues.en: They really exercised very tight control over these businesses.
cues.zh: 他們確實對這些業務實施了非常嚴格的控制。

cues.text: This all began to change in the beginning of the 20th century.
cues.en: This all began to change in the beginning of the 20th century.
cues.zh: 這一切在20世紀初開始改變。

cues.text: We start to see the rise of companies like General Motors
cues.en: We start to see the rise of companies like General Motors
cues.zh: 我們開始看到像通用汽車這樣的公司的崛起

cues.text: and General Electric and RCA.
cues.en: and General Electric and RCA.
cues.zh: 以及通用電氣和 RCA。

cues.text: Companies discovered what Jill discovered, that if you allow the public to buy shares, you can grow a lot faster.
cues.en: Companies discovered what Jill discovered, that if you allow the public to buy shares, you can grow a lot faster.
cues.zh: 公司發現了吉爾的發現，如果你允許大眾購買股票，你可以成長得更快。

cues.text: Shareholders want to make money.
cues.en: Shareholders want to make money.
cues.zh: 股東想賺錢。

cues.text: So if the CEO makes a really bad decision, they'll start selling their shares, which will drive the price down.
cues.en: So if the CEO makes a really bad decision, they'll start selling their shares, which will drive the price down.
cues.zh: 因此，如果執行長做出了非常糟糕的決定，他們將開始出售股票，這將導致價格下跌。

cues.text: The opposite is also true. The possibility of a future payout encourages people to invest in risky new ideas.
cues.en: The opposite is also true. The possibility of a future payout encourages people to invest in risky new ideas.
cues.zh: 反之亦然。未來支付的可能性鼓勵人們投資於有風險的新想法。

cues.text: That's the whole idea of the stock market as a force for good.
cues.en: That's the whole idea of the stock market as a force for good.
cues.zh: 這就是股市作為正義力量的整體概念。

cues.text: It drives companies to make good decisions, so they have more money to give back to shareholders
cues.en: It drives companies to make good decisions, so they have more money to give back to shareholders
cues.zh: 它促使公司做出正確的決策，讓他們有更多的錢回饋股東

cues.text: and more money to grow and create jobs, and that's good for everybody.
cues.en: and more money to grow and create jobs, and that's good for everybody.
cues.zh: 更多的資金用於發展和創造就業機會，這對每個人都有好處。

cues.text: By the middle of the 20th century, the American public corporation
cues.en: By the middle of the 20th century, the American public corporation
cues.zh: 到 20 世紀中葉，美國公營公司

cues.text: was proving itself one of the most effective and powerful
cues.en: was proving itself one of the most effective and powerful
cues.zh: 證明自己是最有效和最強大的之一

cues.text: and beneficial organizations in the world.
cues.en: and beneficial organizations in the world.
cues.zh: 以及世界上有益的組織。

cues.text: There's a sense of growing prosperity, and the telephone company is a grateful participant.
cues.en: There's a sense of growing prosperity, and the telephone company is a grateful participant.
cues.zh: 人們有一種日益繁榮的感覺，電話公司是一個感恩的參與者。

cues.text: Decades after World War II, the stock market helped create the heyday
cues.en: Decades after World War II, the stock market helped create the heyday
cues.zh: 二戰後幾十年，股市創造了鼎盛時期

cues.text: of shared American prosperity.
cues.en: of shared American prosperity.
cues.zh: 共同實現美國繁榮。

cues.text: A new era begins, make the system more democratic, increase the flow of capital for the financing of business.
cues.en: A new era begins, make the system more democratic, increase the flow of capital for the financing of business.
cues.zh: 新時代開始了，讓制度更民主，增加企業融資的資本流動。

cues.text: The corporation really was supposed to be a vehicle
cues.en: The corporation really was supposed to be a vehicle
cues.zh: 公司確實應該是個工具

cues.text: for providing investment opportunities, not just to the very, very wealthy,
cues.en: for providing investment opportunities, not just to the very, very wealthy,
cues.zh: 不僅為非常非常富有的人提供投資機會，

cues.text: but to average Americans.
cues.en: but to average Americans.
cues.zh: 但對一般美國人來說。

cues.text: It's generating superior returns for investors.
cues.en: It's generating superior returns for investors.
cues.zh: 它為投資者帶來了豐厚的回報。

cues.text: Don't you think we ought to invest?
cues.en: Don't you think we ought to invest?
cues.zh: 你不認為我們應該投資嗎？

cues.text: Millions of secure, well-paid jobs.
cues.en: Millions of secure, well-paid jobs.
cues.zh: 數以百萬計的安全、高薪工作。

cues.text: It's producing innovative products that are bought around the globe.
cues.en: It's producing innovative products that are bought around the globe.
cues.zh: 它生產的創新產品銷往全球各地。

cues.text: Executives and directors viewed themselves as stewards or trustees
cues.en: Executives and directors viewed themselves as stewards or trustees
cues.zh: 高階主管和董事將自己視為管理者或受託人

cues.text: of great public institutions that were supposed to serve,
cues.en: of great public institutions that were supposed to serve,
cues.zh: 應該服務的偉大公共機構，

cues.text: not just shareholders, but also bondholders, suppliers, employees, the community.
cues.en: not just shareholders, but also bondholders, suppliers, employees, the community.
cues.zh: 不只是股東，還有債券持有人、供應商、員工、社群。

cues.text: Buick has provided a stomping ground for the cowboy-and-diaper set.
cues.en: Buick has provided a stomping ground for the cowboy-and-diaper set.
cues.zh: 別克為牛仔尿布套裝提供了一個立足之地。

cues.text: And Buick's general manager, Ivan Wiles, drops in.
cues.en: And Buick's general manager, Ivan Wiles, drops in.
cues.zh: 別克的總經理伊凡威爾斯也順便來了。

cues.text: Du Pont...
cues.en: Du Pont...
cues.zh: 杜邦...

cues.text: Modern chemistry and modern industry join hands in serving our modern America.
cues.en: Modern chemistry and modern industry join hands in serving our modern America.
cues.zh: 現代化學和現代工業攜手為我們現代的美國服務。

cues.text: These public corporations helped build the American middle class,
cues.en: These public corporations helped build the American middle class,
cues.zh: 這些上市公司幫助建立了美國中產階級，

cues.text: and for people who knew how to play it right, trading their stocks could build a fortune.
cues.en: and for people who knew how to play it right, trading their stocks could build a fortune.
cues.zh: 對於那些知道如何正確行事的人來說，交易股票可以累積財富。

cues.text: Like this guy.
cues.en: Like this guy.
cues.zh: 就像這個傢伙。

cues.text: ♪ I've been working on the railroad... ♪ Folk music is just his hobby. Mostly, he's the billionaire investor...
cues.en: ♪ I've been working on the railroad... ♪ Folk music is just his hobby. Mostly, he's the billionaire investor...
cues.zh: ♪ 我一直在鐵路工作... ♪ 民間音樂只是他的愛好。大多數情況下，他是億萬富翁投資者...

cues.text: Warren Buffett...

cues.zh: 導致約 450 人失業。

cues.text: The news is devastating, not just to the workers who will lose their jobs, but to the community of Brokaw, where the paper company got its start.
cues.en: The news is devastating, not just to the workers who will lose their jobs, but to the community of Brokaw, where the paper company got its start.
cues.zh: 這個訊息不僅對那些將失業的工人來說是毀滅性的，而且對造紙公司的發源地佈羅考社群也是如此。

cues.text: December 7th, and I'll never forget that, that's when Pearl Harbor was,
cues.en: December 7th, and I'll never forget that, that's when Pearl Harbor was,
cues.zh: 12 月 7 日，我永遠不會忘記，那是珍珠港事件發生的時候，

cues.text: but that's the day I was burying my father, and it's the day I lost my job.
cues.en: but that's the day I was burying my father, and it's the day I lost my job.
cues.zh: 但這是我埋葬父親的日子，也是我失業的日子。

cues.text: Then the next day, I came to work, and it was just a madhouse.
cues.en: Then the next day, I came to work, and it was just a madhouse.
cues.zh: 第二天，我來上班，發現那隻是個瘋人院。

cues.text: You know, people just crying.
cues.en: You know, people just crying.
cues.zh: 你知道，人們只是在哭泣。

cues.text: You know, "Why?" You know? And...
cues.en: You know, "Why?" You know? And...
cues.zh: 你知道，「為什麼？」你知道？和...

cues.text: It was a shock.
cues.en: It was a shock.
cues.zh: 這是一個震驚。

cues.text: My concern is we've evolved to this much shorter-term view
cues.en: My concern is we've evolved to this much shorter-term view
cues.zh: 我擔心的是我們已經發展到這種較短期的觀點

cues.text: on shareholder rights, versus a longer-term view on stakeholder responsibilities.
cues.en: on shareholder rights, versus a longer-term view on stakeholder responsibilities.
cues.zh: 股東權利，與利害關係人責任的長期觀點。

cues.text: This is a trend that's been going on for a while and has gotten even more powerful and important.
cues.en: This is a trend that's been going on for a while and has gotten even more powerful and important.
cues.zh: 這種趨勢已經持續了一段時間，並且變得更加強大和重要。

cues.text: It's seriously threatening the ability of our corporations
cues.en: It's seriously threatening the ability of our corporations
cues.zh: 它嚴重威脅著我們企業的能力

cues.text: to pursue the kinds of projects that lead to long-term corporate sustainability
cues.en: to pursue the kinds of projects that lead to long-term corporate sustainability
cues.zh: 追求能夠實現企業長期永續發展的專案

cues.text: and economic growth.
cues.en: and economic growth.
cues.zh: 和經濟成長。

cues.text: Laying off workers, closing factories, keeping wages low.
cues.en: Laying off workers, closing factories, keeping wages low.
cues.zh: 裁員、關閉工廠、維持低薪。

cues.text: These are things that are bad for the economy overall, but can be great for a company's short-term profits
cues.en: These are things that are bad for the economy overall, but can be great for a company's short-term profits
cues.zh: 這些事情對整體經濟不利，但對公司的短期利潤可能有好處

cues.text: and that's what the stock market cares about.
cues.en: and that's what the stock market cares about.
cues.zh: 這就是股市所關心的。

cues.text: The stock market got off to an impressive start...
cues.en: The stock market got off to an impressive start...
cues.zh: 股市有一個令人印象深刻的開局...

cues.text: Another record today...
cues.en: Another record today...
cues.zh: 今天又創紀錄了...

cues.text: A day for the record books on Wall Street...
cues.en: A day for the record books on Wall Street...
cues.zh: 創下華爾街紀錄的一天…

cues.text: The US economy charges ahead and so do the bulls on Wall Street.
cues.en: The US economy charges ahead and so do the bulls on Wall Street.
cues.zh: 美國經濟向前發展，華爾街的多頭也是如此。

cues.text: This was a big day on Wall Street...
cues.en: This was a big day on Wall Street...
cues.zh: 這是華爾街的重要一天......

cues.text: The S&P 500 has raced out to a new all-time high.
cues.en: The S&P 500 has raced out to a new all-time high.
cues.zh: 標普 500 指數已創歷史新高。

cues.text: As the stock market has grown, so have CEO paychecks.
cues.en: As the stock market has grown, so have CEO paychecks.
cues.zh: 隨著股市的成長，執行長的薪水也在成長。

cues.text: In 1973, the average CEO made about 22 times more
cues.en: In 1973, the average CEO made about 22 times more
cues.zh: 1973 年，CEO 的平均收入約為 22 倍

cues.text: than the average worker.
cues.en: than the average worker.
cues.zh: 比普通工人。

cues.text: By 2016, it was 271 times more.
cues.en: By 2016, it was 271 times more.
cues.zh: 到了2016年，這數字增加271倍。

cues.text: And as the stock market has grown bigger, fewer Americans have benefited.
cues.en: And as the stock market has grown bigger, fewer Americans have benefited.
cues.zh: 隨著股市規模不斷擴大，受益的美國人越來越少。

cues.text: The share of Americans invested in the stock market is at its lowest point
cues.en: The share of Americans invested in the stock market is at its lowest point
cues.zh: 美國人投資股市的比例正處於最低點

cues.text: in 20 years, as the middle class dropped out.
cues.en: in 20 years, as the middle class dropped out.
cues.zh: 20年後，隨著中產階級的退出。

cues.text: So it's no surprise that as stock prices have gone up in the United States,
cues.en: So it's no surprise that as stock prices have gone up in the United States,
cues.zh: 因此，隨著美國股價上漲，也就不足為奇了

cues.text: so has inequality, but it doesn't have to be this way.
cues.en: so has inequality, but it doesn't have to be this way.
cues.zh: 不平等也是如此，但不一定是這樣。

cues.text: Stock markets give people a chance to decide which companies deserve to succeed, which ideas are worth a gamble.
cues.en: Stock markets give people a chance to decide which companies deserve to succeed, which ideas are worth a gamble.
cues.zh: 股票市場讓人們有機會決定哪些公司值得成功，哪些想法值得一搏。

cues.text: There's something about giving people games to play.
cues.en: There's something about giving people games to play.
cues.zh: 提供人們遊戲是有好處的。

cues.text: You look at successful countries and they all have stock markets,
cues.en: You look at successful countries and they all have stock markets,
cues.zh: 你看看成功的國家，他們都有股票市場，

cues.text: and countries that tried to shut them down are coming around and instituting them now.
cues.en: and countries that tried to shut them down are coming around and instituting them now.
cues.zh: 那些試圖關閉它們的國家現在正在轉變並開始實施它們。

cues.text: Stockholders can influence how companies behave, whose interest they take into account.
cues.en: Stockholders can influence how companies behave, whose interest they take into account.
cues.zh: 股東可以影響公司的行為方式，他們會考慮公司的利益。

cues.text: Most of us are thinking about our long-term futures.
cues.en: Most of us are thinking about our long-term futures.
cues.zh: 我們大多數人都在思考我們的長期未來。

cues.text: We care about our neighbors and our children and our grandchildren.
cues.en: We care about our neighbors and our children and our grandchildren.
cues.zh: 我們關心我們的鄰居、我們的子孫。

cues.text: We have values and morals and want our companies to make money
cues.en: We have values and morals and want our companies to make money
cues.zh: 我們有價值觀和道德，希望我們的公司賺錢

cues.text: by doing things that are good for the world and not by harming people and destroying it.
cues.en: by doing things that are good for the world and not by harming people and destroying it.
cues.zh: 做對世界有益的事情，而不是傷害和毀滅人類。

cues.text: That's what most shareholders really want.
cues.en: That's what most shareholders really want.
cues.zh: 這才是大多數股東真正想要的。
